parsed.name: Sensirion EK-H4 温湿度传感器多路复用盒
parsed.name_en: Sensirion EK-H4 humidity and temperature sensor multiplexer box
parsed.description: 用于通过串口连接并读取最多 4 路 Sensirion 温湿度传感器的多路复用采集盒。在实验中可用于环境温度、相对湿度和露点的多通道监测。
parsed.description_en: A multiplexer box that connects over a serial port and reads up to four Sensirion humidity and temperature sensor channels. It is used in laboratory setups for multi-channel monitoring of temperature, relative humidity, and dew point.

actions.description: 初始化 EK-H4 设备通信并准备采集。
actions.description_en: Initialize communication with the EK-H4 and prepare it for data acquisition.

actions.description: 读取指定通道或全部通道的温度。
actions.description_en: Read temperature from a specified channel or from all channels.

actions.description: 读取指定通道或全部通道的相对湿度。
actions.description_en: Read relative humidity from a specified channel or from all channels.

actions.description: 读取指定通道或全部通道的露点。
actions.description_en: Read dew point from a specified channel or from all channels.
